method: PRODUCED - CONSUMED symbol parity (rg across src/, bin/, interfaces/, shared/, desktop/), read-before-write triage

findings.produced: SamplingHandler::set_client(client: Arc<McpClient>) — and downstream ContextInjector::gather_context / format_as_system_message, only reachable via the client field set by set_client
findings.rationale: Both producer (set_client) and consumer (handle_request reading self.client) exist; only the registration call site is missing. Reconnecting is a one-line wire at McpClient::connect / McpServerConnection construction where set_callback is already wired.
findings.proposed_change: In src/mcp/external/connection.rs (next to the existing set_callback at :2030) call sampling_handler.set_client(Arc::new(self.client.clone())) so handle_request can read it.
findings.risk: medium — turns an inert capability into a live one; security review of the <mcp_context trust="untrusted"> fence plus scan_description_for_injection should be re-confirmed before enabling for untrusted servers. Comment at sampling.rs:101 already documents the rationale.
findings.verification: After wiring, an integration test issuing sampling/createMessage with includeContext should observe contexts.len() > 0 in the tracing log at sampling.rs:113.

findings.produced: McpManagerHandle::shutdown() — sends McpCommand::Shutdown to the actor which runs shutdown_all() and emits McpManagerEvent::ManagerShutdown
findings.rationale: Adjacent orderly-shutdown code already calls memory_monitor.shutdown() and channel_health_monitor.shutdown(); only mcp_handle.shutdown() is missing. Reconnect is a 4-line addition.
findings.proposed_change: Add at src/bin/aleph-server/commands/start/mod.rs after line 3681: if let Some(ref h) = mcp_handle { if let Err(e) = h.shutdown().await { tracing::warn!(error = %e, "MCP manager orderly shutdown failed"); } }
findings.risk: low — graceful path is the documented behavior; running servers get a stop signal before process exit instead of being dropped at the channel close.
findings.verification: tracing log at src/mcp/manager/actor.rs:268 ('MCP Manager shutdown complete') should appear on a clean Ctrl-C / SIGTERM; tool_bridge subscribers (already subscribed at tool_bridge.rs:106) should observe McpManagerEvent::ManagerShutdown.

Keeping IdGenerator (MCP-specific atomic counter) at crate::mcp::jsonrpc::IdGenerator (module path) for the in-tree callers at src/mcp/external/connection.rs:135, 273.

Crate-internal callers (src/mcp/external/connection.rs:14, src/mcp/transport/*, src/mcp/modern/mod.rs:32) continue to use crate::mcp::jsonrpc::* paths. findings.consumer_location: none found in production (only test usage at src/mcp/manager/actor.rs:1162, 1320, 1321 and the Debug impl at handle.rs:421)
findings.rationale: Two-line debug aid with no production caller. The only consumer outside the file is in tests; the function is also referenced by the handle's own Debug impl, which can use the raw field directly.

findings.consumer_location: src/mcp/manager/actor.rs:460 and src/mcp/manager/actor.rs:757 (both internal to the actor; no external caller)
findings.rationale: The two production call sites are inside the actor itself; the actor could equally well send McpCommand::SetSamplingCallback directly (which it already does at actor.rs:452 in a third path). Reconnecting adds no new coupling; deleting is also cheap. A future test harness or alternate bootstrap path may want the public method, so the choice is a product call.
findings.proposed_change: Pick one: (1) drop the public method and update the two actor call sites to send McpCommand::SetSamplingCallback directly; or (2) keep as-is — the dead-letter method is small and an external caller may materialize.
findings.risk: low either way — the actor's own with_sampling_bridge path at actor.rs:171-176 (called from bin/aleph-server/commands/start/mod.rs:565) installs the production callback via sampling_bridge::serve_sampling which closes over the command channel directly; the handle method is redundant.
findings.verification: Either path keeps sampling/createMessage working — verified by tracing at src/mcp/sampling.rs:113.
